t: What Vibration Diagnostic Database Is All About
title: What Vibration Diagnostic Database Is All About
description: Vibration signatures name faults: 1× RPM means imbalance, 2× misalignment, bearing tones (BPFO/BPFI) mean race defects, gear mesh frequency means tooth trouble.
